{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 24 is the 52nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 24th day of Capricorn, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 8, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮24日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 52|Chapter 52]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152072}}.
